messages:
Nina: Quick q 50pm visitors (3 ppl) arriving for a product walk-through. Do they need to be on the visitor list or can reception handle on arrival?
Reception: We prefer pre-reg. Email names + company to reception@redwood.com. Same-day registrations ok, we print a temporary paper badge.
Evan: Also: can we block 3 seats in Hotdesk B near the whiteboard? The desk app shows no visitor option.
DeskApp: Guests do not appear on individual bookings. People Ops can reserve visitor seats if submitted.
People Ops: We can reserve the 3 seats for Hotdesk B. Please send full names and expected arrival window. Guest Wi-Fi: `Guest-Redwood` (24h expiry).
Nina: One visitor wants to ship a small prototype ahead of time. Where should the courier drop it?
Reception: Ship to: "Redwood Inference - Front Desk
Attn: Nina (visitor: [company])
[Office street address]". For heavy crates (>25lb) label as "Receiving" and we'll move to receiving dock. Include tracking in the email.
CourierBot: package_arrival_notice: UPS consignment 1 of 1 expected 2024-04-12 10:30, declared weight 8lb.
Evan: If it's fragile pls mark it "Fragile" and email reception with tracking so we can hold it.
People Ops: FYI if guests need temporary Okta access to demo internal staging, include their email addresses. We can create a 48h Okta guest entry.
Nina: Sending names + tracking now. Thanks y'all :heart:
Reception: Noted 510: badges ready at front desk on arrival, buzzer "Front A".
